text: おれに　かって　まんぞくか　じゃ　おうちに　かえんな

structure.jp: おうちに　かえんな

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: な after a verb stem is a short, rough form of なさい, an order from above. かえんな is a slurred かえりな. かえんな = 'go home'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this to what follows, here as the reason for the feeling. かって まんぞくか = 'satisfied now that you've won?'
